## Personality

Milty Boulter is known for taking great pride in his mother, whom others admire for her remarkable resourcefulness. He harbors a strong dislike for being patronized, particularly resenting condescending gestures and remarks.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0019)_

## History

Milty Boulter was a young student who had been attending school for a year. He was considered quite a man of the world relative to the younger children.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), +59 more_
